title: RaceView
description: What clients see of a race. Mirrors extreme-race RaceView field for field and type for type; property and oneOf order follow the Rust field and variant order (the postcard bridge depends on it). Times are absolute epoch milliseconds on the device's clock.

phase.description: Where the race is, with what each phase shows.

oneOf.description: No start sequence running; the line can be set.
Counting down to the start at start_time.
Racing since start_time; the line is no longer shown.

heading.description: Course over ground, degrees true (f32); 0 until the first GPS update after the start.

Time.description: Epoch milliseconds on the device's clock (u64).

LineView.description: The start line, as far as it has been set.

oneOf.description: Only the starboard end is set.
Only the port end is set.
Both ends: on the current course the boat crosses the line cross percent of the way along it (0 = port end, 100 = starboard end) at time (in the past if sailing away from it).
